name: Morse.IsConjugate
hypotheses: γ is a smooth curve in N on [0,1] (Morse.IsSmoothCurveIn hN γ), e.g. a geodesic as in Milnor
difference: Both require a ≠ b in [0,1] and a Jacobi field on [0,1] vanishing at a and b and nonzero somewhere on [0,1]; the only difference is inherited from Morse.IsJacobiField: the project imposes the Jacobi equation on (0,1), the blind on [0,1] with one-sided derivatives, which can differ only when γ is not smooth up to the ends (outside Milnor's hypothesis that γ is a geodesic).
why: Same dictionary as for Morse.IsJacobiField (blind T_xN/P/II/R = project tangentSubspace/prj/dN P/curvR; blind covD within [0,1] = covAlong), giving IsJacobiField hN γ J ↔ IsJacobiOn N γ [0,1] J for γ smooth in N; the rest of the two definitions is the same conjunction up to order (`tauto`).
